Sound

One-tap volume
Mute for

Mutes the sound and brings it back by itself after the time you pick - handy for a loud ad or intro. Tap the counting chip again to bring the sound back sooner.

Night volume

Between 10 pm and 7 am the volume is capped at the level you pick. Your normal volume stays saved for the day.

When on, the volume you pick is remembered for each video and comes back the next time you play it. Songs can stay loud and lectures quiet.

Fade in

When a video starts or you press Play, the sound rises slowly from silence to your volume. Gentle on the ears, especially at night.

Fade out at the end

In the last seconds of a video the sound sinks slowly to silence, so a song never cuts off mid-note. Your normal volume comes back for the next video.

When earphones or Bluetooth headphones come off, the video pauses so your place is not lost. Works in browsers that report device changes (Chrome, Edge); other browsers keep it off.

Speed

Picks a speed from 1x to 2x for the part left to watch. An estimate for recorded videos; pauses, loops and ads can add time.

Remember a speed for this channel and it applies by itself when one of its videos plays. A speed saved for the video itself wins.

Quality

Remember a quality for this channel and it applies by itself when one of its videos plays. Data saver still wins while it is on.

Every video plays at your chosen quality. Data saver still wins while it is on.

Data and battery saver

Data saver asks YouTube for 480p on each video you load and stops thumbnail images in your lists. Battery saver uses the same lighter effects as Low-end mode. On OLED screens, the Dark theme saves battery too.

Keyboard shortcuts
  • Space or K: play / pause
  • Left / Right: back / forward 5 seconds
  • J / L: back / forward 10 seconds
  • Up / Down: volume up / down
  • M: mute, F: full screen, R: loop on / off, N: next in queue
  • 0 - 9: jump to 0% - 90% of the video
  • C: subtitles on / off
  • ?: show or hide this list
  • A / B: set loop points A and B, X: clear the A-B loop
  • T: cinema mode on / off
  • S: save this moment
  • , / .: previous / next saved moment
  • Ctrl+V: paste a video link anywhere on the page
  • < / >: slower / faster playback speed
  • P: previous in queue
  • W: save the playing video to Watch later (press again to remove)
  • Y: copy a link that opens this video at the current time
  • G: jump to the Jump to time box, type a time and press Enter
  • H: add the playing video to Favourites (press again to remove)
  • U: jump back to where you were before the last seek
  • D: switch between dark and light theme
  • Q: find the video playing now in the queue
  • I: copy the video title and link, ready to paste in a chat
  • Z: skip the playing video and remove it from the queue
  • E: add the playing video to the end of the queue
  • Home / End: jump to the start / end of the video
  • O: open the playing video on YouTube at the same second
  • Shift + Left / Right: back / forward 1 second
  • /: focus the library search

Shortcuts work when the page itself is focused (click outside the video first). Picture-in-picture: many browsers offer it from the video itself, for example right-click the video twice on desktop Chrome.

          Help and FAQ

          What's new

          The latest additions to the app - tap one to jump straight to it.

            How do I play a video?

            Paste any YouTube link in the first box and tap Load video. You can also add several links to the queue and they will play one after another.

            Can I download YouTube videos?

            No. YouTube does not allow downloading, so this app plays YouTube links in the player instead. The downloader works for many other sites, for example TikTok, TED, SoundCloud and Streamable.

            Why does the downloader say "waking up the free server"?

            The download helper runs on a free server that sleeps when nobody uses it. The first request wakes it, which can take up to a minute. After that it is fast.

            How do I add a whole YouTube playlist?

            Paste the playlist link in the first box and tap "Add playlist to queue". Every video in the list is added to your queue (up to the 50-video queue limit).

            Why is YouTube volume limited to 100%?

            YouTube's own player does not allow more than 100%. For louder sound, open a file from your device in the "Play a file" card - it can boost volume up to 300%.

            Where are my queue and favourites saved?

            In this browser, on this device only. Use "Export backup" in Your videos to save them, with your settings, to a file, and "Import backup" to load everything on another device or browser.

            Can I listen with the phone screen off?

            See the Listening help card below the player for simple steps and the screen-off limits.

            The page is very long. Can I hide parts of it?

            Yes. Tap a section's title or the round arrow next to it to fold that section away, and tap again to bring it back. The "Collapse all" button at the top folds everything in one tap. For an even cleaner page, Simple mode (in Settings) hides the advanced cards and keeps only the everyday controls - one tap brings everything back, and your choice is remembered on this device.

            Does the app work offline?

            Once installed, the app opens without internet and your queue, favourites and settings are still there. Playing videos and downloading need internet.

            What is sent anywhere?

            Your queue, favourites and settings never leave your device. The download server only receives the link you ask it to fetch, and its files are deleted after 15 minutes. This app shows no ads of its own and has no trackers.

            Accessibility

            Stops app animations, ripples, smooth scrolling and vibration. Video playback is unchanged. Your device's reduced-motion setting always takes priority.

            App color

            Pick any colour

            Changes the main accent color of the app. Saved on this device.

            The app also follows your device settings for reduced motion and contrast. Keyboard shortcuts are listed under the player, and every control works with a keyboard and a screen reader.

            Settings

            Everything the app remembers is stored on this device only: volume, speed, theme, language, queue modes, the sleep timer and saver choices.

            Private viewing is on: videos you open are not added to Recently watched, Continue watching or Watch stats until you turn it off. Favourites, queue and Watch later still work.

            Shows only the link box, the player with everyday controls, and Help. Your videos, the downloader and other advanced cards are hidden. Nothing is deleted - one tap brings everything back.

            Handy when a call or another app pulls you away. Off by default; both are remembered on this device.

            Report a problem

            This builds a short report on your device: app state, the last error shown, browser and screen size. It never includes passwords, links you typed, or personal data. Read it below, then send it with your own email app or copy it.
